WITH qc_by_project AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_projects,
    SUM(count) as total_records
  FROM qc_by_project
)
SELECT 
  q.arcref as project,
  q.count,
  CAST(q.count AS REAL) / t.total_records as share,
  CAST(q.count AS REAL) / t.total_records - 1.0 / t.num_projects as deviation
FROM qc_by_project q
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY deviation DESC
LIMIT 10;
